build_starlette_app: build a Starlette app with GET and POST routes for a HuggingFace inference pipeline
create_get_pipeline: create a cached function that returns a pipeline instance based on TASK and MODEL_ID environment variables
configure_allowed_tasks: configure the ALLOWED_TASKS dictionary to map task names to their corresponding Pipeline classes
setup_cors_middleware: setup CORS middleware on the Starlette app when DEBUG environment variable is set to 1
review_startup_event: review the startup_event async function that configures uvicorn logging and attaches get_pipeline to the app
